response.overview: Vom Geist der Schwere! Become a ghost at noon, open a spectral drift with no terminus—escape, defection, exile, nomadism—from this point on one cannot be pinned down by any exact and unshifting identification in time or in coordinates. Under the shadow of the state machine’s perpetual operation, hauntology emerges as a methodology of survival against a pervasive spiritual decline—even as it all is ultimately destined to fail.
response.title: 白日离魂
